I know this is /v/funny, but if you're serious:

  • you can only upvoat a certain number of times until you reach 20 comment contribution points (ccp, aka upvoats), then you can upvoat to your hearts content
  • you can only downvoat once you reach 100 ccp
  • you can find specific subverses by clicking "more>>" on the top right corner of your screen
  • You can change the subverses listed at the top of the screen to your subscribed subverses by clicking on the little cog beside your username at the top right, then under User Preferences check "Replace top menu bar with my subscriptions"
  • There is a mobile app for Android called "boats for voat", it's in it early stages. It has potential, but needs work. iOS is working on one as well, nothing released yet, though.

That's the basics of it. Hope this helps.
